answer: Proposal: synchronous issuance. Issuers hold simultaneous in-person signings; each event is an inlet admitting one body, one key, and the registry mints one opal credential per attendee. Weight counts opals, not accounts: n identities need n people present at once, since nobody attends two ceremonies simultaneously. Aliases then cost real wages, rational only where an opal's reward beats the hiring price — no haven for ghost armies. Assumes honest issuers verifying presence and true simultaneity; buying keys from attendees stays the open attack.
